name: en-np-clause-v1
description: The full generator: rich noun phrases (determiner, number, adjective, plural) inside clauses, with the SUBJECT's number driving verb agreement (the cat drinks / the cats drink; Does the cat / Do the cats). Stacks glossary + plural/3sg/past rules + NP order + clause constructions, all field-stored. Numbers force plural and pluralise the noun via the learned plural rule. Generation from given roles+features; not parsing.
cases: Two big cats drink the water.
The cat sees the small fish.
Do the cats drink the water?
Does the cat drink the water?
The cats do not drink the water.
The three small dogs loved the fish.
The girl loves the big book.
